broadApiRule.name: api-rate-limit-ip
broadApiRule.requiredExpression: (http.host eq "api.pharos.watch" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not (http.request.uri.path in {"/api/telegram-webhook" "/api/telegram-mini-app/session" "/api/telegram-mini-app/mutate"}) and not cf.bot_management.verified_bot)

exactPathRules.name: telegram-webhook-ingress-limit
exactPathRules.expression: (http.host eq "api.pharos.watch" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/telegram-webhook")

exactPathRules.name: telegram-mini-app-session-ingress-limit
exactPathRules.expression: (http.host eq "api.pharos.watch" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/telegram-mini-app/session")

exactPathRules.name: telegram-mini-app-mutation-ingress-limit
exactPathRules.expression: (http.host eq "api.pharos.watch" and http.request.method eq "POST" and http.request.uri.path eq "/api/telegram-mini-app/mutate")
